features: RAPID IPS IMAGE QUALITY, FRAMELESS GAMING - MSI Rapid IPS panel monitors provide outstanding color intensity, and support 178° wide viewing angles; A 'frameless' design reduces bezel lines between screens

24.5” (62.23cm) FHD, 200 HZ RAPID IPS - A high definition 1920 x 1080 Rapid IPS panel (16:9) features a high 200 Hz refresh rate for smooth movement tracking; A very low 0.5ms (GtG, Min.) response time is ideal for esports events. Brightness 300 nits.

WIDE COLOR GAMUT - The MAG 255F E20 supports up to 1.07 billion colors (8-bit + FRC) colors at 100% sRGB for high color accuracy; Features Anti-Flicker and Less Blue Light reducing the amount of flicker and displaying lower levels of blue light.

DYNAMIC CONTRAST & AI VISION - The Rapid IPS panel comes with a 1000:1 native contrast, and supports Dynamic Contrast (100M:1); MSI AI Vision, a smart black tuner, enriches details in dark areas and optimizes brightness and colors.
HDMI CEC CONNECTIVITY - console & laptop interface options include DisplayPort 1.2a (FHD@200Hz) & HDMI 2.0b (FHD@200Hz) CEC ports; The monitor rear features a 5-way joystick navigator
